Now let me compile the research into a comprehensive report for you: ## Research Summary: pantoken instui- Component Reference ### 1. **Authoring Conventions (Key Findings from docs/conventions/authoring.md)** **Modifier convention:** - Single-dash modifiers: `-color-secondary`, `-size-sm`, `-variant-secondary` (component-specific) - Double-dash modifiers: `--bg-secondary`, `--p-sm`, `--mb-md`, `--display-flex` (global utilities, chainable to any component) - Booleans: presence means true (`-clickable`); default-on booleans inverted (`-without-border`, `-without-background`) - Sizes use scale: `-size-{xs,sm,md,lg,xl}` plus aliases like `-size-small` **Critical gotcha for your refactor:** - Global spacing/gap utilities (`--margin-*`, `--padding-*`, `--gap-*`, `--bg-*`, `--text-*`, etc.) use **double-dashes** and are applied via `globalModifierSelector` with (0,3,0) specificity — they **override component-specific single-dash modifiers** deterministically - Component-owned `margin`/`padding`/`gap` from tokens get documented in `@remarks` with a warning that chaining spacing utilities will override them - Never invent a parallel utility class — reuse existing global ones (`--bg-*`, `--text-*`, `--border-*`, `--display-*`, `--gap-*`) --- ### 2. **Available Components & Utilities Catalog** #### **Components** (`formats/components/src/components/`) **Key ones for your refactor:** - `tabs` — tabbed panels with `-variant-secondary` (folder-style tabs) - `view` — neutral box primitive with modifiers for background, border, radius, shadow, display, position, overflow, cursor - `card` — doesn't exist as separate; use `instui-view` or `instui-card` (might be an alias/demo pattern) - `simple-select` — native `` or `` inside `

{"command": "create", "path": "/memories/session/plan.md", "file_text": "# Plan: Migrate AgentToolsPage.vue to pantoken instui classes

## Context
- User already reworked the "bootstrap" tab section as a reference pattern: `instui-heading`,
  `instui-text -color-secondary`, `instui-view --border-radius-lg --padding-xs --background-ai-horizontal`,
  `instui-simple-select`, `instui-button` w/ modifiers (`-size-sm -color-secondary -on-color
  -without-border --mt-xs -icon-copy`). Main tabs already use `instui-tabs` w/ `.list`/`.tab`/`.panel`
  structure. Docs tab already uses `instui-card`, `instui-link -size-small`. Install tab already uses
  `instui-toggle-group` (details) and `instui-radio-input-group -variant-toggle` for the asset filter.
- Researched `formats/components/src/utilities/{layout,gap,spacing}` and `components/{view,tag,pill,list,tabs}`:
  - Global double-dash utilities exist for: `display` (`block/inline-block/inline/flex/inline-flex/none`
    — **no `grid`**), `text-align`, `gap` (spacing-scale steps, short+long spellings), spacing
    (`margin`/`padding`, short+long).
  - `view`'s background/border-radius/border-width/border-color/shadow/position/overflow/cursor
    modifiers (single-dash, e.g. `-background-secondary`, `-border-radius-small`) are documented as
    globally chainable onto any element, not just `instui-view`.
  - No utility exists for `flex-direction`, `flex-wrap`, `align-items`, `justify-content`, or
    `display: grid` — these must stay as minimal scoped CSS since pantoken has no primitive for them.
  - `instui-list -unstyled -inline` gives `display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:<token>`
    with no markers/padding — an exact match for the current `agent-tools-page__links` custom CSS.
  - `pill`/`tag` don't fit the `__path` code-chip use case (status label / dismissible chip, not a
    monospace value); keep `<code>` but drop the custom color/padding/background rule in favor of
    chaining `-background-secondary -border-radius-small` (global view modifiers).

## Steps

1. **Audit & delete dead CSS.** Confirm via template scan that these scoped classes are unused, then
   remove their rules: `agent-tools-page__launcher`, `__form-grid`, `__field`, `__select`, `__input`,
   `__path-list`, `__writes`, `__link-row`, `__command-bar`, `__command-text`, `__open-icon`,
   `__asset-content` (rendering moved into `AgentAssetEmbed.vue`).
2. **Replace list-of-cards wrappers with `instui-list`.** *(depends on 1)*
   - `agent-tools-page__links` (`<ul>` in docs tab) → `instui-list -unstyled -inline`; drop the
     matching custom flex/gap/wrap CSS block entirely.
   - `agent-tools-page__asset-links` (`<ul>` of small links in docs tab) → `instui-list -unstyled`
     (block list); if the current 0.375rem inter-item gap needs to be preserved and no display change
     is desired, keep only a one-line scoped rule for that gap (no pantoken primitive covers vertical
     `<li>` gap without flex/grid, which isn't otherwise wanted here).
3. **Collapse "stack" sections onto instui-view + gap utilities where the utility fully covers the need.**
   - `agent-tools-page__hero` (`display:grid;gap:.75rem`) and each `agent-tools-page__panel`
     (`display:grid;gap:1rem`) are vertical stacks — no `flex-direction`/`grid` utility exists, so keep
     a single minimal scoped rule per class limited to `display:flex;flex-direction:column`, and replace
     the hardcoded `gap` value with the matching `--gap-md`/`--gap-sm` utility class applied in the
     template instead of in the scoped block.
   - `agent-tools-page__asset-heading` (`display:grid;gap:.125rem`) → same treatment, chain `--gap-2xs`.
4. **Chain global view modifiers for one-off visuals instead of hand-rolled colors/radii.** *(parallel with 2-3)*
   - `agent-tools-page__path` chip: drop custom background/color/padding CSS; keep a `<code>` element
     with `instui-text -size-x-small` typography plus chained `-background-secondary -border-radius-small`
     (global view modifiers) directly on the element; leave only the (currently absent-from-utilities)
     inline padding as a tiny scoped rule since no padding-shorthand utility targets inline text chips
     cleanly — verify a `--padding-*` utility can be chained instead before adding custom CSS here.
5. **Tidy remaining custom CSS.** *(depends on 1-4)*
   - Keep truly page-shell/unique rules only: `.agent-tools-page` max-width/padding, absolute
     positioning for the copy/open buttons over the prompt (`__copy`, `__open`), the shiki `pre`/`code`
     overrides inside the prompt container, and the `@media (max-width: 640px)` responsive tweak.
   - Re-check every remaining scoped rule against `docs/conventions/authoring.md`'s "never invent a
     parallel utility" rule — anything matching an existing `--gap-*`/`--margin-*`/`--padding-*`/
     `--display-*`/`-background-*`/`-border-radius-*` should move to a template class instead of CSS.
6. **Verify.** *(depends on 1-5)*
   - `vp check --fix` (format/lint) and `vp test` per repo convention.
   - Manually preview the docs site page for AgentToolsPage (bootstrap/install/docs tabs) in a browser
     to confirm no visual regression, especially the docs-tab card grid wrap behavior and the install
     tab's asset list spacing/copy-download button alignment.

- `docs/.vitepress/theme/components/GetStartedTabs.vue`, `CdnPicker.vue` — reference patterns already

- `formats/components/src/components/list/list.css` — `-unstyled -inline` modifier reference.

- `formats/components/src/utilities/{layout,gap,spacing}/index.ts` — confirms which double-dash

- `docs/.vitepress/theme/components/AgentAssetEmbed.vue` — likely renders what used to be
  `__asset-content`; confirm no leftover custom styling duplicates removed CSS (read-only check, not
  in scope to change further unless it also has convertible custom CSS).

## Decisions
- Scope is limited to `AgentToolsPage.vue`. `AgentAssetEmbed.vue` is out of scope unless inspection
  shows it needs the same treatment — flagged as a possible follow-up, not blocking this change.
- Where pantoken has no layout primitive (flex-direction, flex-wrap, align-items, grid), minimal

  radius values move to instui utility/modifier classes.
- `__path` chip keeps the `<code>` element (semantic) but sheds custom background/color CSS for
  chained global `view` modifiers.

## Further Considerations
1. Should the vertical gap in `agent-tools-page__asset-links` (currently 0.375rem) be preserved exactly,

4. *(parallel with 2-3)* `__path` code chip: drop custom background/color/padding CSS, chain global `view` modifiers (`-background-secondary -border-radius-small`) plus `instui-text -size-x-small` directly on the `<code>` element.
5. *(depends on 1-4)* Tidy what's left — only page-shell max-width/padding, absolute positioning for the copy/open buttons over the prompt, shiki pre/code overrides, and the mobile media query should remain as scoped CSS.
6. *(depends on 1-5)* Verify: `vp check --fix`, `vp test`, and a manual browser check of all three tabs (card grid wrap, asset list spacing/button alignment).

- `docs/.vitepress/theme/components/AgentAssetEmbed.vue` — check for duplicate leftover styling (read-only, out of scope unless it needs the same treatment)

**Decisions**
- Scope limited to `AgentToolsPage.vue`; `AgentAssetEmbed.vue` flagged as a possible follow-up only.
- Custom scoped CSS is kept only where no pantoken primitive exists (flex-direction, flex-wrap, align-items, grid) — not forcing an awkward workaround.

content.text:
Committed cleanly, leaving the unrelated `l10n/docs.api.pot` change untouched for whoever owns it. ## Root cause & fix The inconsistent spacing wasn't missing base/prose CSS — `instui-heading` zeroes its own `margin` and `instui-text` sets none at all, so any spacing you saw was coming from ambient sources (browser `

` defaults, VitePress's `.vp-doc` heading margins) rather than pantoken tokens. That produces visibly different gaps depending on which ambient rule happened to win the cascade, plus one earlier leftover (`--my-md` on just the bootstrap tab's `

`) that wasn't applied anywhere else. Fixed by making every heading/paragraph explicitly own its spacing instead of inheriting it: - Added `--m-0` to every `instui-heading`/`instui-text` element in the file (hero, all three section intros, doc-tab link-card title/description) to fully zero out margins. - Wrapped each section's heading+description pair in a `.agent-tools-page__intro` flex-column with `--gap-2xs`, replacing the one-off `--my-md`. - Caught a real regression from the earlier refactor: `.agent-tools-page__link-card` had lost its `display:flex`/gap entirely (dropped when I removed the old `display:grid;gap:.75rem` without adding an equivalent utility) — its title/description/link-list had no spacing between them at all. Restored via `--display-flex --gap-sm` on the card plus `flex-direction: column` in scoped CSS. Verified with `vp check --fix` (clean, 582 files) and committed as `fix(docs): normalize heading/paragraph spacing on Agent Tools page` with its own changeset.
